prompt: Our cloud contract supports a critical function. Which DORA provisions set the required contract clauses, and where do exit strategies sit?
assertions: Article 30(2) is the baseline clause set for ALL ICT service contracts
Article 30(3) adds the stricter set for critical or important functions
Exit strategies with a mandatory transition period sit at 30(3)(f)
Unrestricted audit, access and inspection rights belong to the 30(3) critical/important set
Register of Information duties (maintain and submit annually) sit in Article 28(3)
